x-draft: ADR-0027 (proposed): the manifest a stateful slot's export writes and its import_ is held to (follow-up 7); not frozen, may change before acceptance, when the slot protocols gain export and import_
title: Export manifest
description: What a stateful slot's export wrote (ADR-0027, proposed; docs/modules.md, 'Import validation'): the slot and its export format, every file's relative path, size and sha256, and the totals. An importer holds the tree to it exactly: no file missing or extra, every size and digest equal, no link or special file. The rules a schema cannot state (paths unique case-insensitively, no file under another file, totals equal to the sums, the importer's limits, the tree itself) are in homelabnext.modules.importcheck.

slot.description: the stateful slot the export is of (a slot registry key)

path.description: relative POSIX path: no leading '/', no empty, '.' or '..' segment, no backslash or control character
